metadata.title: Transmission Lines, Fields, and Waves
metadata.description: A learning graph for EE3601, a junior-level undergraduate course that starts with transmission lines, impedance matching and transients and builds up through electrostatics, magnetostatics and Maxwell's equations to plane waves, reflection, waveguides and antennas.
metadata.creator: Hye Yoon Park
